title: Why Apple Is About To Search Your Files

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for Dealbook, a daily newsletter at the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》每日时事通讯《Dealbook》的商业与政策记者。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市Dealbook峰会的现场，采访商界、政界和文化界的一些重量级领袖，包括J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde, Zilran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the Dealbook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经滤镜的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch, free, at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 我们将在11月18日于nytimes.com上直播部分精选采访，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并免费获得我们所有新闻内容一个月的访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望大家准时收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: Previously on The Daily.
sentences.zh: 回顾《每日新闻》往期内容。

sentences.en: So we started doing this test across a number of different search engines.
sentences.zh: 于是我们开始在多个不同的搜索引擎上进行这项测试。

sentences.en: And to sit there and watch as the program starts ticking away, and see the first time it flashes that it got a match,
sentences.zh: 坐在那里看着程序开始倒计时，看到它第一次闪烁提示找到了匹配项，

sentences.en: and then to see it match again, and match again, and match again.
sentences.zh: 然后看到它再次匹配、再次匹配、又再次匹配。

sentences.en: A Times investigation revealed an epidemic of child sexual abuse material.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的一项调查揭露了一场儿童性虐待材料的泛滥危机。

sentences.en: Any platform that allows the sharing of files is going to be absolutely infested with child sexual abuse.
sentences.zh: 任何允许文件共享的平台都必然充斥着儿童性虐待内容。

sentences.en: On a staggering scale.
sentences.zh: 其规模令人震惊。

sentences.en: They told us that in 2018 alone, they received over 45 million images and videos.
sentences.zh: 他们告诉我们，仅在2018年，他们就收到了超过4500万张图片和视频。

sentences.en: An epidemic that relies on platforms run by the world's largest tech companies.
sentences.zh: 这场泛滥的危机依赖于由全球最大科技公司运营的平台。

sentences.en: Every major tech company is implicated.
sentences.zh: 每一家大型科技公司都牵涉其中。

sentences.en: In page after page after page, we see social media platforMs.
sentences.zh: 在一页又一页的资料中，我们看到了社交媒体平台。

sentences.en: Facebook, Kik, Tumblr.
sentences.zh: 脸书，Kik，Tumblr。

sentences.en: We see cloud storage companies.
sentences.zh: 我们看到了云存储公司。

sentences.en: Google Drive, Dropbox.
sentences.zh: 谷歌云端硬盘、Dropbox。

sentences.en: And that those companies are aware of.
sentences.zh: 而且这些公司对此是知情的。

sentences.en: And from these documents, it becomes clear that the companies know.
sentences.zh: 从这些文件中可以明显看出，这些公司心知肚明。

sentences.en: I mean, there's so many cases for each company that they all know.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，每家公司都有如此多的案例，以至于它们全都知道。

sentences.en: But have done little to try to stop.
sentences.zh: 但却几乎没有采取任何措施去试图阻止。

sentences.en: Why are these images and videos still showing up on some of the largest technology platforms in the world?
sentences.zh: 为什么这些图片和视频仍然出现在世界上某些最大的科技平台上？

sentences.en: The tech companies, they have to do something about it.
sentences.zh: 科技公司必须采取行动。

sentences.en: Today, Kevin Roos spoke to our colleague, Jack Nickus, about how one company is now taking action, and why those actions are triggering a heated debate over privacy.
sentences.zh: 今天，凯文·罗斯与我们的同事杰克·尼克斯谈论了一家公司目前如何采取行动，以及这些行动为何引发了关于隐私的激烈争论。

sentences.en: It's Friday, August 20th.
sentences.zh: 今天是8月20日，星期五。

sentences.en: Jack, I remember a few years ago, our colleagues at the Times had this big, multi-part investigation
sentences.zh: 杰克，我记得几年前，《时报》的同事们曾对此做过一项大型的多部分调查，

sentences.en: of child sexual abuse material, what used to be called child porn.
sentences.zh: 关于儿童性虐待材料，也就是以前所谓的儿童色情。

sentences.en: What was the reaction to that investigation inside the tech world?
sentences.zh: 科技界对那项调查有什么反应？

sentences.en: I think that that investigation opened a lot of eyes.
sentences.zh: 我认为那项调查让很多人大开眼界。

sentences.en: There was a sense that this is an enormous problem, and it is happening on our watch.
sentences.zh: 人们有一种感觉，这是一个极其严重的问题，而且它正在我们的眼皮底下发生。

sentences.en: Now, different companies had different opinions, and that's because some companies were actually
sentences.zh: 现在，不同的公司有不同的看法，这是因为有些公司实际上

sentences.en: quite good at reporting child sexual abuse images, and some companies were quite bad.
sentences.zh: 非常擅长举报儿童性虐待图片，而有些公司则非常糟糕。

sentences.en: Facebook, for instance, was reporting millions of images each year, and a company like Apple was reporting just a few hundred.
sentences.zh: 例如，Facebook每年举报数百万张图片，而像苹果这样的公司只举报了几百张。

sentences.en: So at certain companies like Apple, there was a feeling that they weren't doing enough.
sentences.zh: 因此，在苹果等某些公司内部，有一种感觉认为他们做得还不够。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Because the conclusion of this investigation was basically that tech companies can, in theory,
sentences.zh: 因为那项调查的结论基本上是，科技公司在理论上可以

sentences.en: find ways to kind of scour their platforms and find these horrible images and kind of match them against known child sexual abuse images that are gathered by these activist groups,
sentences.zh: 找到方法在其平台上进行搜查，找出这些可怕的图片，并将其与这些维权组织收集的已知儿童性虐待图片进行比对，

sentences.en: and that that was maybe what they should be doing more of if they're a company that doesn't monitor for much of this stuff.
sentences.zh: 如果它们是一家对这类内容监控不多的公司，这或许正是它们应该做更多事情的方向。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And there were some proven methods to do so, and therefore, there certainly were, I think, reasonable questions on why more companies weren't doing more to attack such a pernicious
sentences.zh: 而且有一些经过验证的方法可以做到这一点，因此，我认为人们当然会产生合理的疑问：为什么更多的公司没有采取更多行动来打击这样一个祸害深远的问题。

sentences.en: problem.
sentences.zh: 问题。

sentences.en: So what has been happening at Apple in the two years since this investigation?
sentences.zh: 那么在过去两年里，自这项调查以来苹果发生了什么？

sentences.en: Well, after that investigation came out, there actually was a hearing in Congress in late
sentences.zh: 嗯，在那项调查发表后，2019年底国会确实就加密问题举行了一场听证会。

sentences.en: 2019 about encryption.
And one of the things that happened at that hearing was some members of Congress told
sentences.zh: 那场听证会上发生的事情之一是，一些国会议员对苹果说：

sentences.en: Apple, if you're not going to solve this problem, we're going to force you to do it.
sentences.zh: 如果你们不解决这个问题，我们将强迫你们去解决。

sentences.en: And what we know is around that time or sometime after, Apple set out to figure this out.
sentences.zh: 据我们所知，大约在那时或之后的某个时候，苹果开始着手弄清楚这一点。

sentences.en: And last week, kind of out of nowhere, Apple abruptly made an announcement that it had indeed figured it out, and it was going to do a lot more to try to combat child sexual abuse
sentences.zh: 上周，苹果毫无征兆地突然宣布，它确实已经搞清楚了，并且将采取更多措施在其产品上打击儿童性虐待。

sentences.en: on its products.
sentences.zh: 产品上。

sentences.en: And what was this announcement?
sentences.zh: 这个宣布是什么？

sentences.en: What did Apple say it was going to do?
sentences.zh: 苹果说它打算做什么？

sentences.en: So essentially, there are three separate tools that are part of this announcement.
sentences.zh: 从本质上讲，这项宣布包含三个独立的工具。

sentences.en: The first one involves Siri, the virtual assistant that Apple has on iPhones.
sentences.zh: 第一个工具涉及Siri，即苹果在iPhone上内置的虚拟助手。

sentences.en: Going forward, people who ask Siri how to report child sexual abuse will be pointed to resources for that.
sentences.zh: 展望未来，向Siri询问如何举报儿童性虐待的用户将被引导至相关求助资源。

sentences.en: And also people who search for child sexual abuse imagery will be pointed to resources to get help with their issue.
sentences.zh: 此外，搜索儿童性虐待图像的人也将被引导至获取相关问题帮助的资源。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: That sounds pretty straightforward.
sentences.zh: 听起来挺直接的。

sentences.en: What's the next one?
sentences.zh: 下一个是什么？

sentences.en: The second part of their announcement involved text messages.
sentences.zh: 他们宣布的第二部分涉及短信。

sentences.en: And basically, it is a feature for parents to turn on for their children.
sentences.zh: 基本上，这是一项供父母为孩子开启的功能。

sentences.en: And if a child is under 13 and receives or tries to send a nude image, the parents can be notified of that.
sentences.zh: 如果孩子未满13岁且接收或尝试发送裸照，家长将会收到通知。

sentences.en: If there's a child between 13 and 17 years old, that child will at least be warned and asked whether or not they truly want to view or send a nude image in a text message.
sentences.zh: 如果有13至17岁的青少年，该青少年至少会收到警告，并被询问是否真的希望在短信中查看或发送裸照。

sentences.en: And Apple is not looking at those photos.
sentences.zh: 而且苹果并没有在查看那些照片。

sentences.en: Presumably, that's just being done by artificial intelligence or some algorithm is determining like, that looks like a nude photo.
sentences.zh: 据推测，这只是通过人工智能或某种算法在判断，比如：这看起来像一张裸照。

sentences.en: Let's warn your parents or ask you if you really want to send that.
sentences.zh: 让我们警告你的父母或者问问你是否真的想发送。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So what Apple has said is that the way this works is that for a child's device on which this feature is turned on, every photo that is either sent or received in a text message
sentences.zh: 所以苹果所说的工作原理是，对于开启了此功能的儿童设备，在短信中发送或接收的每一张照片

sentences.en: will be scanned by this artificial intelligence machine learning that analyzes it and tries to determine whether or not it includes nudity.
sentences.zh: 都将通过这种人工智能机器学习进行扫描，该技术对其进行分析，并试图确定其中是否包含裸露内容。

sentences.en: And if it does, then either a parent will be notified or the child will be warned.
sentences.zh: 如果有，那么要么会通知家长，要么会向儿童发出警告。

sentences.en: Okay, so that's the second change.
sentences.zh: 好的，这是第二个改变。

sentences.en: What's the third?
sentences.zh: 第三个是什么？

sentences.en: So the final change is that Apple is going to create software that scans photos on people's iPhones to see if there are matches in a database of known images of child sexual abuse.
sentences.zh: 最后的改变是，苹果将创建一款软件，扫描人们iPhone上的照片，看它们是否与已知的儿童性虐待图片数据库中的内容相匹配。

sentences.en: And if there are enough matches, Apple will report those photos to authorities.
sentences.zh: 如果有足够的匹配项，苹果将把这些照片举报给执法部门。

sentences.en: And so some people have described this as the first time that you can get in trouble and get reported to the police for simply having something on your device.
sentences.zh: 因此，有些人将其描述为：你仅仅因为设备上存有某种东西，就会陷入麻烦并被举报给警方，这还是头一次。

sentences.en: And how is that approach different from the kinds of scanning that, for example, Google
sentences.zh: 这种方法与例如谷歌在您存储于谷歌相册（Google Photos）中的照片上可能进行的扫描，或者Facebook在你上传到其服务的照片上可能进行的扫描有何不同？

sentences.en: might do on the photos that you store in Google Photos or that Facebook might do on the photos that you upload to its services?
sentences.zh: 服务上？

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: So in many cases in the past, companies like Facebook and Dropbox are doing scanning on photos that have been uploaded to those companies' servers.
sentences.zh: 在过去很多情况下，像Facebook和Dropbox这样的公司是对上传到这些公司服务器上的照片进行扫描。

sentences.en: And so there is somewhat, you know, an assumption that once I share these photos and upload them
sentences.zh: 因此，某种程度上，你知道，人们会有一种假设：一旦我分享了这些照片并将它们上传到另一家公司的服务器，

sentences.en: to another company's servers, they no longer are completely my property and other companies
sentences.zh: 它们就不再完全属于我个人，其他公司可以对这些照片是什么以及它们是否违法采取更积极的态度。

sentences.en: can be a little more aggressive in what those photos are and whether or not they break the law.
sentences.zh: 法。

sentences.en: But in this case, Apple's approach involves looking at photos that are stored on a user's device.
sentences.zh: 但在这种情况下，苹果的方法涉及查看存储在用户设备上的照片。

sentences.en: That they might have felt were not visible to anyone except themselves.
sentences.zh: 他们可能觉得除了自己之外没有人能看到这些照片。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So it is important to note that Apple is only doing this scanning on photos that a user has also chosen to upload to iCloud.
sentences.zh: 因此，请务必注意，苹果仅对用户选择上传到iCloud的照片进行这种扫描。

sentences.en: And if a user doesn't want their photos to be scanned, they can simply turn off iCloud backups.
sentences.zh: 如果用户不希望自己的照片被扫描，他们只需关闭iCloud备份即可。

sentences.en: But that is a policy decision because the first part of the scanning is done on the device itself.
sentences.zh: 但这是一个政策决定，因为扫描的第一部分是在设备本身上完成的。

sentences.en: And so ostensibly, if Apple wanted to, it could scan and search all the photos on a person's device, not just ones that are being uploaded to iCloud.
sentences.zh: 因此，表面上看，如果苹果愿意，它本可以扫描和搜索个人设备上的所有照片，而不仅仅是那些正在上传到iCloud的照片。

sentences.en: Yeah, that does feel like a pretty big difference.
sentences.zh: 是的，这确实感觉是一个相当大的区别。

sentences.en: It's sort of like the difference between a friend who calls the cops on you if you bring drugs to his house
sentences.zh: 这有点像这样的区别：一个朋友，如果你把毒品带到他家，他会报警抓你；

sentences.en: versus a friend who has the ability to see inside your house, see whether you have any drugs there, and then telling the cops if he sees any.
sentences.zh: 对比另一个朋友，他有能力看穿你家内部，看你那里是否有毒品，如果看到了就会报警。

sentences.en: It certainly is a much more powerful investigative tool for law enforcement.
sentences.zh: 对执法部门来说，这无疑是一个威力大得多的调查工具。

sentences.en: I'm sure that the way that Apple has figured out to scan for this material is very complicated and technical,
sentences.zh: 我确信苹果想出的扫描这种材料的方法非常复杂且具技术性，

sentences.en: but can you just describe on a basic level how this scanning and detection works?
sentences.zh: 但你能否从基础层面简单描述一下这种扫描和检测是如何工作的？

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: So Apple basically reduces each photo to a set of numbers.
sentences.zh: 所以苹果基本上把每张照片都简化为一组数字。

sentences.en: And this is kind of like a fingerprint.
sentences.zh: 这有点像指纹。

sentences.en: It's called a hash.
sentences.zh: 它被称为哈希值（hash）。

sentences.en: And it means that each photo has its own unique code.
sentences.zh: 这意味着每张照片都有其独特的代码。

sentences.en: And so there already is a database that's been created by child safety groups like the National Center for Missing and Exploited Children
sentences.zh: 因此，诸如国家失踪与被剥削儿童中心等儿童安全组织已经创建了一个数据库，

sentences.en: that have also reduced known images of child sexual abuse to similar codes, these hashes.
sentences.zh: 它们也将已知的儿童性虐待图片简化为了类似的代码，即这些哈希值。

sentences.en: And so Apple will take the hashes that it creates from your photos, and it will match it against this database of known abuse imagery and see if there are matches.
sentences.zh: 因此，苹果会获取它从你的照片中创建的哈希值，并将其与这个已知的虐待图像数据库进行比对，看是否有匹配项。

sentences.en: And once there are 30 or more matches, an Apple employee will then review versions of these photos to see if there is indeed child sexual abuse.
sentences.zh: 一旦有30个或更多的匹配项，苹果的一名员工就会随后审查这些照片的版本，以确认其中是否确实存在儿童性虐待行为。

sentences.en: And if there is, then that will be sent to the authorities and the person's account will be locked.
sentences.zh: 如果有，那么这些将被发送给执法部门，此人的账户将被锁定。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Why 30 matches?
sentences.zh: 为什么是30个匹配项？

sentences.en: Why not one or two?
sentences.zh: 为什么不是一个或两个？

sentences.en: It's a good question.
sentences.zh: 这是一个好问题。

sentences.en: Apple talks about setting this higher threshold in part because it wants to ensure that it is only looking at the photos of an actual child abuser.
sentences.zh: 苹果谈到设定这个较高的门槛，部分原因是为了确保它只针对真正的儿童虐待者的照片进行审查。

sentences.en: Essentially,
sentences.zh: 本质上，

sentences.en: Apple is trying to create a very high bar to ensure that people who aren't looking at child sexual abuse imagery aren't having their photos looked at by an Apple employee.
sentences.zh: 苹果试图设定一个非常高的标准，以确保那些没有浏览儿童性虐待图像的人的照片不会被苹果员工查看。

sentences.en: And this process of making the hashes and matching them up against the database of hashes of known child sexual abuse images,
sentences.zh: 那么，生成哈希值并将其与已知儿童性虐待图片哈希值数据库进行比对的这个过程，

sentences.en: is this going to be happening on every Apple device, every iPhone and iPad and all the billion plus Apple devices are going to start scanning for this kind of material right away?
sentences.zh: 是否会发生在每一台苹果设备上，每一部iPhone、iPad以及总共超过十亿台的苹果设备都会立即开始扫描这类材料吗？

sentences.en: No, what it does mean is that the technology and the capability will now be built into the new operating system on every new iPhone.
sentences.zh: 不，这意味着这项技术和功能现在将被内置到每一部新iPhone的新操作系统中。

sentences.en: But it only will be turned on in the U.S., at least at the start.
sentences.zh: 但它最初只会美国境内启用。

sentences.en: And this is basically Apple being asked to do more following this investigation to stop the spread of this horrible imagery.
sentences.zh: 这基本上是要求苹果在这次调查之后做更多的工作，以阻止这种可怕图像的传播。

sentences.en: And this is them basically saying, we're doing more.
sentences.zh: 这基本上是他们在说：我们在做更多的事情。

sentences.en: This is our plan.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们的计划。

sentences.en: This is how we're going to step up our detection and our enforcement, you know, against this material.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们将如何加大对这种材料的检测和打击力度。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And I think that for many parents and law enforcement groups and child safety groups,
sentences.zh: 我认为，对于许多父母、执法部门和儿童安全组织来说，

sentences.en: this is a set of really common sense measures that are going to protect children and give parents more oversight over their children's lives and and hopefully, you know,
sentences.zh: 这是一套非常符合常识的措施，将保护儿童并让父母对孩子的生活有更多监督，并且希望，你知道的，

sentences.en: root out a really pernicious problem from one of the most popular tech platforms in the world.
sentences.zh: 从世界上最受欢迎的科技平台之一中根除一个祸害深远的问题。

sentences.en: And so I think there's been a lot of praise for these changes.
sentences.zh: 因此，我认为这些改变受到了很多赞扬。

sentences.en: It actually seems like an instance in which a problem was shown and a tech company responded in a real substantive way.
sentences.zh: 这实际上似乎是一个这样的例子：发现了一个问题，而一家科技公司以真正实质性的方式做出了回应。

sentences.en: And you said that there was a lot of praise, but obviously with any change this monumental, I mean, scanning photos on potentially more than a billion devices,
sentences.zh: 你刚才说有很多赞誉，但显然，对于任何如此重大的改变——我的意思是，在可能超过十亿台设备上扫描照片——

sentences.en: it can't be universally welcomed, right?
sentences.zh: 不可能受到普遍欢迎，对吧？

sentences.en: Far from it.
sentences.zh: 远非如此。

sentences.en: In fact, even though child sexual abuse is obviously illegal and completely abhorrent, and there is near consensus in Silicon Valley that this is a problem we're solving,
sentences.zh: 事实上，尽管儿童性虐待显然是非法的且完全令人发指，硅谷也几乎达成共识认为这是一个我们需要解决的问题，

sentences.en: Apple's approach kind of ignited a firestorm in many corners of Silicon Valley.
sentences.zh: 但苹果的方法在硅谷的许多角落引发了一场风暴。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁版？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to The Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，你需要订阅《时报》才能访问所有的报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore The Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但是，如果你能免费探索《时报》一个月，且无需输入信用卡呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你就可以。

sentences.en: When you download The New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在该应用中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么内容。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to The New York Times, download The Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是《纽约时报》的订阅者，请立即下载《时报》应用程序，并获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: So, Jack, you said there's been a firestorm over these changes by Apple.
sentences.zh: 那么，杰克，你说苹果的这些改变引发了一场风暴。

sentences.en: What are the company's critics saying is wrong here?
sentences.zh: 该公司的批评者认为这里有什么问题？

sentences.en: The thing that they're most concerned about is the precedent that this sets.
sentences.zh: 他们最担心的是这开创了一个先例。

sentences.en: For the first time,
sentences.zh: 这是第一次，

sentences.en: this is a major tech company that has created a technology that can go into someone's private device and look at their personal information or data and decide whether or not that data breaks the law and should be reported to authorities.
sentences.zh: 一家大型科技公司创造了一项技术，可以进入某人的私人设备，查看其个人信息或数据，并决定该数据是否违法以及是否应该举报给执法部门。

sentences.en: And privacy advocates and civil liberties lawyers and cybersecurity experts are all pretty concerned about the potential for abuse that governments and law enforcement around the world can see this technology and say,
sentences.zh: 隐私倡导者、公民自由律师和网络安全专家都对这项技术可能带来的滥用感到相当担忧，因为世界各地的政府和执法部门看到它后会认为：

sentences.en: Oh, wow, that would be great to surveil certain portions of the population or to look for dissidents of the government.
sentences.zh: 哦，太棒了，这非常适合用来监视部分人口，或者搜寻政府的异见人士。

sentences.en: And now that Apple has created this technology, they're worried it's kind of difficult to put it back in the box.
sentences.zh: 既然苹果已经开发了这项技术，他们担心这就很难再将其收回去了。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Yeah, it does seem kind of surprising that Apple is the company doing all this.
sentences.zh: 是的，苹果竟然是做出这一切的公司，这确实让人感到有些惊讶。

sentences.en: Because up to this point, all of their sort of marketing and promotion has been around their sort of ironclad commitment to privacy.
sentences.zh: 因为在此之前，他们所有的营销和宣传都围绕着他们对隐私的坚定承诺展开。

sentences.en: I mean, I drive past a billboard for iPhones every day that says something like, you know, what happens on your iPhone stays on your iPhone.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我每天开车经过一块iPhone的广告牌，上面写着类似于“你在iPhone上的一切，都会留在iPhone上”的话。

sentences.en: And so this move from Apple feels particularly surprising given what they've been saying.
sentences.zh: 鉴于他们过去的言论，苹果的这一举动让人感到格外意外。

sentences.en: Indeed, you know, privacy has been at the center of Apple's brand and certainly its marketing pitch for many years now.
sentences.zh: 确实，你知道，隐私多年来一直处于苹果品牌的核心地位，当然也是其营销宣传的重点。

sentences.en: And this kind of goes back to the mass shooting in San Bernardino in 2015.
sentences.zh: 这可以追溯到2015年圣贝纳迪诺的枪击案。

sentences.en: The suspects have been identified as Saeed Farouk and his wife, Tashfeen Malik.
sentences.zh: 嫌疑人已被确定为赛义德·法鲁克及其妻子塔什芬·马利克。

sentences.en: The FBI says it found a smartphone used by Farouk that could contain critical evidence.
sentences.zh: 联邦调查局表示，他们找到了法鲁克使用的一部智能手机，其中可能包含关键证据。

sentences.en: Investigators think it might have important information on the couple's whereabouts.
sentences.zh: 调查人员认为，这可能掌握着这对夫妇下落的重要信息。

sentences.en: You know, the FBI in that case wanted to get into the gunman's phone, and it couldn't.
sentences.zh: 你知道，在那起案件中，联邦调查局想要解开枪手的手机，但做不到。

sentences.en: Apple is now being ordered to help the FBI break in.
sentences.zh: 苹果现在被命令协助联邦调查局破解手机。

sentences.en: Federal agents argue they just want a one-time weapon in the fight against terror.
sentences.zh: 联邦特工辩称，他们只是想要一把打击恐怖主义的一次性武器。

sentences.en: And so it asked Apple to figure out how to get in.
sentences.zh: 因此，他们要求苹果想办法破解。

sentences.en: Apple is refusing to hack into Saeed Farouk's iPhone despite a court order to help.
sentences.zh: 尽管法院下令要求提供协助，但苹果仍拒绝黑入赛义德·法鲁克的iPhone。

sentences.en: Most of the tech world has lined up behind Apple as the company fights a judge's order to unlock the data and the work issue.
sentences.zh: 随着苹果公司抗拒法官关于解锁数据和相关事宜的命令，科技界的大多数人选择支持苹果。

sentences.en: And Apple's response was, listen, we built these phones with really strong encryption, and that means that if we don't know the passcode, we can't get in.
sentences.zh: 苹果的回应是，听着，我们在制造这些手机时采用了非常强大的加密技术，这意味着如果我们不知道密码，我们就无法进入。

sentences.en: A new CBS News New York Times poll suggests that Americans are divided over whether Apple should unlock the encrypted iPhone.
sentences.zh: 哥伦比亚广播公司新闻部和《纽约时报》的一项新民意调查显示，美国人对苹果是否应该解锁加密的iPhone意见不一。

sentences.en: Digital rights advocates agree with Apple.
sentences.zh: 数字权利倡导者与苹果立场一致。

sentences.en: Protesters rallying at Apple stores to support the tech giant's refusal.
sentences.zh: 抗议者在苹果专卖店聚集，支持这家科技巨头的拒绝举动。

sentences.en: A lot of people feel very strongly.
sentences.zh: 许多人的立场非常坚定。

sentences.en: They are chanting again, so a lot of people coming out here tonight to voice their opinion.
sentences.zh: 他们再次喊起了口号，因此今天晚上有很多人来到这里表达他们的意见。

sentences.en: But some family members of those fatally shot and wounded weighing in as well.
sentences.zh: 但一些被枪杀和受伤人员的家属也发表了看法。

sentences.en: The husband of one of those killed in the San Bernardino shootings says Apple is wrong.
sentences.zh: 圣贝纳迪诺枪击案中一名遇难者的丈夫表示，苹果做错了。

sentences.en: And Apple was ready to go to court against the FBI on this issue.
sentences.zh: 在这场风波中，苹果已准备好就此问题与联邦调查局对簿公堂。

sentences.en: What is at stake here is, can the government compel Apple to write software that we believe would make hundreds of millions of customers vulnerable around the world?
sentences.zh: 这里危及的核心问题是：政府是否可以强迫苹果编写我们认为会使全球数亿客户面临风险的软件？

sentences.en: And actually in that case, you know, Apple's principal argument was it would be very dangerous for us to build that.
sentences.zh: 事实上，在那个案件中，你知道，苹果的主要论点是开发这种软件对我们来说将非常危险。

sentences.en: A piece of software that we view as sort of the software equivalent of cancer.
sentences.zh: 我们认为这种软件堪称软件界的毒瘤。

sentences.en: Because if we build a way into this encrypted phone, that means that we now will likely have to use it in many other cases when we are facing demands from governments.
sentences.zh: 因为如果我们为这部加密手机开辟了一条捷径，这就意味着将来面对政府的要求时，我们很可能也得在许多其他案件中如法炮制。

sentences.en: And that is an important point in this scenario, in the context of today's debate, because, you know, in the past,
sentences.zh: 在今天的辩论背景下，这是这个场景中的一个重要点，因为，你知道，在过去，

sentences.en: if a government had asked Apple to search the photos on a person's iPhone,
sentences.zh: 如果政府要求苹果搜索某人iPhone上的照片，

sentences.en: Apple would say the operating system on the iPhone literally will not allow us to do that.
sentences.zh: 苹果会说，iPhone上的操作系统从字面上讲就不允许我们这样做。

sentences.en: We can't do it.
sentences.zh: 我们做不到。

sentences.en: But now that Apple has actually built the technology into the iPhone software, it now can't argue we can't do that.
sentences.zh: 但既然苹果实际上已经在iPhone软件中内置了这项技术，它现在就不能再辩称我们做不到了。

sentences.en: It only can argue we won't do that.
sentences.zh: 它只能辩称我们不会这样做。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And that feels like a pretty big difference.
sentences.zh: 这感觉是一个相当大的区别。

sentences.en: That is what privacy groups are so worried about, that Apple will have far less leverage in those conversations with law enforcement and governments.
sentences.zh: 这也是隐私组织如此担忧的原因，即苹果在与执法部门和政府的对话中将拥有少得多的谈判筹码。

sentences.en: The system will already be present on the phone.
sentences.zh: 这个系统将已经存在于手机上。

sentences.en: It will be much more difficult for Apple to push back against demands to use it for different purposes.
sentences.zh: 苹果将更难抗拒将其用于不同目的的要求。

sentences.en: And what is Apple's track record on those sorts of requests from law enforcement or prosecutors to get into people's devices?
sentences.zh: 对于执法部门或检察官要求进入人们设备的这类请求，苹果的历史记录如何？

sentences.en: Well, it's pretty mixed.
sentences.zh: 嗯，可以说是毁誉参半。

sentences.en: What we can say is that in the U.S., Apple has, as we noted, they've pushed back against the FBI several times about trying to build a backdoor into encryption.
sentences.zh: 我们可以说的是，在美国，正如我们所指出的，苹果曾多次拒绝联邦调查局试图在加密中留后门的企图。

sentences.en: But they also do provide the contents of people's iCloud accounts to law enforcement.
sentences.zh: 但他们也确实向执法部门提供了人们iCloud账户的内容。

sentences.en: Now, that only happens with a warrant, but that's data that's not fully encrypted.
sentences.zh: 当然，这只有在有搜查令的情况下才会发生，但这些数据并未完全加密。

sentences.en: And Apple has said under the law, we're required to turn it over with a warrant.
sentences.zh: 苹果曾表示，根据法律规定，凭搜查令我们必须交出这些数据。

sentences.en: And we do.
sentences.zh: 我们确实也这么做了。

sentences.en: But we've also seen Apple make compromises in other countries.
sentences.zh: 但我们也看到苹果在其他国家做出了妥协。

sentences.en: We reported earlier this year that in China, Apple has made a number of compromises that really contradict its principles on privacy.
sentences.zh: 我们今年早些时候曾报道过，在中国，苹果做出了一些切实违背其隐私原则的妥协。

sentences.en: Most notably, Apple is now storing the data of its Chinese customers on servers that are owned and run, in effect, by the Chinese government.
sentences.zh: 最显著的是，苹果现在正将其中国客户的数据存储在实际上由中国政府拥有和运营的服务器上。

sentences.en: So the fear of privacy advocates, if we sort of follow this slippery slope down,
sentences.zh: 因此，如果我们沿着这条滑坡效应走下去，隐私倡导者的担忧就在于，

sentences.en: is that if the Chinese government asked Apple to scan iPhones for something that isn't child sexual abuse material,
sentences.zh: 如果中国政府要求苹果扫描iPhone以查找并非儿童性虐待材料的内容，

sentences.en: like, you know, photos of the Tiananmen Square massacre or something, then Apple not only could technically do that,
sentences.zh: 比如，你知道的，天安门广场大屠杀的照片或类似内容，那么苹果不仅在技术上能够做到这一点，

sentences.en: but they might just go ahead and do it in order to be allowed to continue to do business in China.
sentences.zh: 而且他们很可能会直接照做，以便获准继续在中国开展业务。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: That is the concern.
sentences.zh: 这就是人们担忧所在。

sentences.en: And you have to consider that, you know, Apple is a private company.
sentences.zh: 你必须考虑到，你知道，苹果是一家私营公司。

sentences.en: They want access to markets.
sentences.zh: 他们需要进入市场。

sentences.en: And in a place like China, they also want access to the supply chain.
sentences.zh: 在像中国这样的地方，他们还需要进入供应链。

sentences.en: They build virtually all of their products in China and are hugely dependent upon the country.
sentences.zh: 他们几乎所有的产品都在中国制造，并且高度依赖这个国家。

sentences.en: So when the Chinese government asks for something, it's very difficult for Apple to say no.
sentences.zh: 因此，当中国政府提出要求时，苹果很难说不。

sentences.en: And that is not just the case in China.
sentences.zh: 这种情况不仅发生在中国。

sentences.en: Apple wants access to a lot of markets.
sentences.zh: 苹果希望进入许多市场。

sentences.en: And increasingly, governments across the world are becoming more concerned about not being able to get access to individual citizens' devices.
sentences.zh: 而且，世界各地的政府越来越担心无法访问普通公民的设备。

sentences.en: And so we're seeing similar sorts of demands happen in India.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们在印度也看到了类似的诉求。

sentences.en: And we're also seeing similar legislation being considered in Europe.
sentences.zh: 我们还看到欧洲正在审议类似立法。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: And I guess that is what is giving rise to this fear that ultimately Apple's tool, this tool to detect child sexual abuse material, might turn into something much darker,
sentences.zh: 我想这正是引发这种恐惧的原因，即最终苹果的这个工具——这个用于检测儿童性虐待材料的工具——可能会变成更黑暗的东西，

sentences.en: like scanning people's text messages on their iPhones to see who is disloyal to an authoritarian regime.
sentences.zh: 比如扫描人们iPhone上的短信，看看谁对威权政权不忠诚。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: You know, I think at the beginning, you could think about it being used for child sexual abuse or to look for mentions or images related to terrorist activity.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我认为一开始，你可以认为它被用于打击儿童性虐待，或者寻找与恐怖主义活动相关的提及或图像。

sentences.en: But, you know, certain governments have been shown to try to find dissidents of the government.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，事实证明某些政府一直在试图寻找政府的异见人士。

sentences.en: Or in some places, it's illegal to be gay.
sentences.zh: 或者在某些地方，同性恋是违法的。

sentences.en: There are a lot of things that would really run against Apple's values, and I think Western values, that could be abused using this sort of technology.
sentences.zh: 有很多事情确实违背了苹果的价值观，我认为也违背了西方价值观，而这些事情可能会利用这种技术遭到滥用。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: I guess one thing I keep coming back to is this question over trade-offs between detecting child sexual abuse material and, you know,
sentences.zh: 我想我一直在反复思考的一个问题是，在检测儿童性虐待材料与，你知道的，

sentences.en: giving people a sense that what's on their phone will stay on their phone.
sentences.zh: 让人们有一种手机上的内容会留在手机里的安全感之间，进行权衡取舍的问题。

sentences.en: And I guess the question that sort of leads into that is, like, how effective do we think this tool is actually going to be?
sentences.zh: 我想由此引发的问题是，比如说，我们认为这个工具实际上会有多大效果？

sentences.en: Like,
sentences.zh: 比如说，

sentences.en: does Apple and do people who study child sexual abuse think that scanning people's phones for this kind of imagery is really going to be a significant step in ending the distribution of this content?
sentences.zh: 苹果以及研究儿童性虐待问题的人士是否认为，扫描人们的手机以查找此类图像，真的是结束这种内容传播的重要一步？

sentences.en: Or maybe it will just drive people to different platforms where their devices and accounts won't be scanned?
sentences.zh: 还是说它只会把人们推向不同的平台，在那里他们的设备和账户不会被扫描？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I think that, at the very least, we can say it is better than the alternative in terms of combating child sexual abuse.
sentences.zh: 我认为，至少我们可以说，在打击儿童性虐待方面，它比其他替代方案要好。

sentences.en: It almost certainly will catch some people, and Apple's numbers of reports will certainly rise.
sentences.zh: 它几乎肯定会抓获一些人，苹果的报告数量也肯定会上升。

sentences.en: How effective it will be remains to be seen.
sentences.zh: 它究竟能发挥多大效用还有待观察。

sentences.en: So what does Apple say to all of this criticism and feedback?
sentences.zh: 那么苹果对所有这些批评和反馈是怎么说的呢？

sentences.en: How are they responding to the privacy advocates?
sentences.zh: 他们是如何回应隐私倡导者的？

sentences.en: You know, I actually asked Apple that on a briefing at the end of last week, and their response was one of frustration.
sentences.zh: 你知道，上周末结束的一次简报会上，我实际上就此询问了苹果，他们的回应充满了沮丧。

sentences.en: I think that they feel like they're not getting the benefit of the doubt, that they are trying to thread the needle on a really difficult problem.
sentences.zh: 我认为他们觉得他们没有得到信任，他们正试图在一个极其棘手的问题上走钢丝。

sentences.en: They say that they're doing their best to create as many safeguards as possible,
sentences.zh: 他们表示，他们正在尽最大努力建立尽可能多的保障措施，

sentences.en: and they really think that they've created a solution that both solves a difficult problem and protects the privacy of their users,
sentences.zh: 而且他们真的认为自己创造了一种解决方案，既能解决一个难题，又能保护用户的隐私，

sentences.en: and that the privacy groups should trust that Apple will turn down governments if they make demands to abuse this sort of tool.
sentences.zh: 隐私组织应该相信，如果有政府提出滥用这种工具的要求，苹果会予以拒绝。

sentences.en: So I think there's a lot of frustration at Apple that it's being criticized for, in their minds, trying to do the right thing.
sentences.zh: 因此，我认为苹果内部充斥着一种沮丧情绪，因为在他们看来，自己是在努力做正确的事情，却遭到了批评。

sentences.en: And have they changed their plans or walked back any of these proposed changes in response to all this criticism?
sentences.zh: 为了应对所有这些批评，他们是否改变了计划，或者撤回了任何这些拟议的更改？

sentences.en: They haven't yet walked anything back, but they did announce additional safeguards.
sentences.zh: 他们尚未撤回任何内容，但他们确实宣布了额外的保障措施。

sentences.en: So a few days after the initial announcement, Apple said that it was going to have a third-party auditor involved to ensure that the system was working effectively and safely.
sentences.zh: 因此，在最初宣布几天后，苹果表示将引入第三方审计机构，以确保系统有效且安全地运行。

sentences.en: But I don't think Apple is going to be able to make changes that will appease privacy groups, because their concern is about the fundamental nature of what Apple is proposing.
sentences.zh: 但我认为苹果无法做出能够平息隐私组织怒火的改变，因为他们的担忧关乎苹果所提议案的根本性质。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Because their objection isn't about how this is being implemented, it's that it's happening at all.
sentences.zh: 因为他们的反对意见不在于它是如何实施的，而在于它根本就不应该发生。

sentences.en: It's more of a foundational objection.
sentences.zh: 这更多是一种根本性的反对意见。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: What the privacy groups are saying is, what you've proposed here is very dangerous.
sentences.zh: 隐私组织所说的是，你们在这里提议的东西非常危险。

sentences.en: Jack, that feels like a pretty hard-line stance to me,
sentences.zh: 杰克，在我看来这是一种相当强硬的立场，

sentences.en: and I'm just thinking back to our colleagues' investigation and the horrible stories they found about these families of children who had been victimized,
sentences.zh: 我回想起我们同事的调查以及他们发现的关于受害儿童家庭的恐怖故事，

sentences.en: and how they would eventually have to tell those children that there were these images of them on the internet, and that they might not be able to get rid of them.
sentences.zh: 他们最终不得不告诉那些孩子，互联网上存在着他们的这些照片，而且他们可能无法将这些照片彻底抹去。

sentences.en: And I guess the question that this all raises is, like, what is the price that we are collectively willing to pay to protect those people to stop this from happening?
sentences.zh: 我想这一切提出的问题是，为了保护这些人、阻止这种情况发生，我们集体愿意付出什么代价？

sentences.en: Yeah, I think that's what makes this so tricky, is that what Apple is trying to solve here is a very real, active problem, and one that has real victiMs.
sentences.zh: 是的，我认为这正是使问题变得如此棘手的原因，苹果试图解决的是一个非常真实、现实的问题，而且这是一个有真正的受害者的问题。

sentences.en: And the other side of it is more concerned about theoretical harm.
sentences.zh: 而另一方则更多地担心理论上的伤害。

sentences.en: But that theoretical harm is also really worrisome.
sentences.zh: 但这种理论上的伤害同样令人十分担忧。

sentences.en: And so both sides have really important and, I think, valid viewpoints here.
sentences.zh: 因此，双方都有非常重要且我认为站得住脚的观点。

sentences.en: And unfortunately, they both seem to be in contradiction.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，这两者似乎是矛盾的。

sentences.en: And that means for a company like Apple and for many of the tech companies that are trying to figure this out, there are really few easy solutions.
sentences.zh: 这意味着对于像苹果这样的公司以及许多正试图弄清这一问题的科技公司来说，几乎没有什么简单的解决方案。

sentences.en: And are there alternatives here?
sentences.zh: 这里还有其他替代方案吗？

sentences.en: Like, are there ways that Apple could protect people's privacy in a way that privacy advocates found sufficient,
sentences.zh: 例如，苹果有没有办法在隐私倡导者认为足够充分的情况下保护人们的隐私，

sentences.en: while also doing enough to stop the spread of child sexual abuse material?
sentences.zh: 同时又采取足够的行动来阻止儿童性虐待材料的传播？

sentences.en: Or does it kind of have to be one or the other?
sentences.zh: 还是说必须非此即彼？

sentences.en: Well, the thing is, that's exactly what Apple set out to do.
sentences.zh: 嗯，问题是，这正是苹果着手要做的事情。

sentences.en: You know, for years, Apple ignored this problem in some ways, because they were concerned about privacy.
sentences.zh: 你知道，多年来，苹果在某种程度上一直忽视这个问题，因为他们担心隐私问题。

sentences.en: And they set out to figure out a way to do both, to create a solution that solved this very real problem, while also protecting their users' privacy.
sentences.zh: 他们着手寻找一种兼顾两者的方法，即创建一个既能解决这个非常现实的问题，又能保护用户隐私的解决方案。

sentences.en: And Apple really thought that it had done that.
sentences.zh: 苹果真的以为自己已经做到了这一点。

sentences.en: But now, given the reaction, I think it's pretty clear that it's not nearly as easy as Apple had thought.
sentences.zh: 但现在，鉴于各方的反应，我认为很明显，事情远没有苹果想象的那么简单。

sentences.en: Jack, thank you.
sentences.zh: 杰克，谢谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他内容。

sentences.en: Throughout the past week on the show, we've met Afghans who are desperately trying to find a way out of the country, now that the Taliban has taken control.
sentences.zh: 在过去一周的节目中，我们采访了一些阿富汗人，随着塔利班夺取控制权，他们正拼命寻找离开该国的方法。

sentences.en: I think it's the worst day of my life to see what I'm seeing.
sentences.zh: 看到眼前这一切，我认为这是我一生中最糟糕的一天。

sentences.en: One of them was a 33-year-old woman and vocal critic of the Taliban who asked that we refer to her as R to protect her identity.
sentences.zh: 其中一位是一名33岁的女性，也是塔利班的公开批评者，她要求我们称她为R，以保护她的身份。

sentences.en: We are just waiting to see how, if we will be able to make it to the airport sometime soon.
sentences.zh: 我们正在等待看如何能够、以及是否能够在不久的将来赶到机场。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: After days of trying to secure a seat on a flight, she finally got word she would be leaving soon on a plane to France.
sentences.zh: 在连续几天努力争取航班座位后，她终于接到消息，说她很快就会搭乘飞往法国的飞机离开。

sentences.en: So, we are on the plane, ready to take off.
sentences.zh: 所以，我们已经在飞机上，准备起飞了。

sentences.en: And I have all different kind of emotions, mixed emotions, sadness, grief, anger, outrages, and disappointment, hopelessness.
sentences.zh: 我有各种各样的情绪，悲喜交加，有悲伤、悲痛、愤怒、气愤、失望和绝望。

sentences.en: And at the same time, I'm just praying to the universe that I will be back soon.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，我只是在向上天祈祷，希望我能很快回来。

sentences.en: Yeah, I hope it happens soon.
sentences.zh: 是的，我希望这一天快点到来。

sentences.en: R landed in Paris on Thursday.
sentences.zh: R于周四在巴黎降落。

sentences.en: Now that she's safe, R told the Times we could reveal her full name, Radha Akbar.
sentences.zh: 既然她现在安全了，R告诉《时报》我们可以透露她的全名：拉达·阿克巴（Radha Akbar）。

sentences.en: We also told the story of Abdul, the interpreter who worked for the U.S.
sentences.zh: 我们还讲述了阿卜杜勒的故事，他曾是一名美军翻译，

sentences.en: Army and was seeking a visa that would let he and his family resettle in the United States.
sentences.zh: 他当时正在寻求签证，以便他和家人能够在美国重新定居。

sentences.en: After the Taliban arrived in Kabul, Abdul said he made his way to the airport with his wife and two children.
sentences.zh: 在塔利班抵达喀布尔后，阿卜杜勒说他带着妻子和两个孩子前往机场。

sentences.en: As they saw the Taliban, everybody that I know, jumping on the wall.
sentences.zh: 当他们看到塔利班时，我认识的所有人都在往墙上跳。

sentences.en: He's also starting firing from the U.S.
sentences.zh: 美军这一侧也开始开火。

sentences.en: Army side also.
sentences.zh: （注：此句承接上文美军方向）美军阵地这边也开始开火了。

sentences.en: But after several hours there, they were turned away.
sentences.zh: 但在那里待了几个小时后，他们被赶了回来。

sentences.en: I just heard from Abdul, this man and his family should not be in this situation.
sentences.zh: 我刚收到阿卜杜勒的消息，这个人和他的家人本不该陷入这种境地。

sentences.en: Colin Daniels, who worked alongside Abdul as a lieutenant in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 科林·丹尼尔斯（Colin Daniels）曾作为美军中尉与阿卜杜勒并肩作战，他一直在关注着阿卜杜勒的遭遇。

sentences.en: Army, has been following his journey.
sentences.zh: （注：最后一条尾音呼应）

sentences.en: The long story short is that we took direction from the State Department after putting him on the list of people who are going to try to be evacuated.
sentences.zh: 简单来说，我们在把他列入尝试撤离人员名单后，听从了国务院的指示。

sentences.en: He was told to wait and shelter in place.
sentences.zh: 他被告知原地等待并就地避难。

sentences.en: But he just sent me two video messages from his safe house that the Taliban is setting up a checkpoint right outside.
sentences.zh: 但他刚刚从他的安全屋发来两段视频消息，称塔利班正在外面设卡盘查。

sentences.en: So we're running out of options.
sentences.zh: 所以我们的选择不多了。

sentences.en: So for now, Abdul and his family are in hiding in an undisclosed location in Kabul, watching the Taliban out their window and hoping that the Taliban doesn't find them.
sentences.zh: 因此，目前阿卜杜拉和他的家人正躲在喀布尔的一个秘密地点，看着窗外的塔利班，祈祷塔利班不要发现他们。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Eric Krupke, Rob Zipko, and Chelsea Daniel, with help from Lindsay Garrison.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由埃里克·克鲁普克、罗布·齐普科和切尔西·丹尼尔制作，林赛·加里森提供了协助。

sentences.en: It was edited by Dave Shaw, contains original music by Mary Lozano and Dan Powell, and was engineered by Chris Wood.
sentences.zh: 节目由戴夫·肖剪辑，包含玛丽·洛萨诺和丹·鲍威尔的原创音乐，由克里斯·伍德担任音响工程。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: See you on Monday.
sentences.zh: 周一见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》将为您准备节日期间的待客之道。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让客人家外如归的实用技巧。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们对光线极度敏感吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们喝到断片才去睡觉。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是指，他们需要什么样的光线环境？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有对什么过敏或饮食禁忌吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们习惯喝咖啡还是茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 您可以在《纽约时报》应用程序或您喜欢的任何播客平台上找到《Wirecutter秀》。
